name: Gmail
description: Your Gmail in lanes (Unread, Alerts with Grafana grouping, Read), read-only, one Google account per project through your own OAuth client (the panel walks you through it). Open a thread as a clean page with its images, annotate it and discuss it with Claude. Sorted by priority when Jev triage (bronos.jev-triage) is installed. Needs cc-cockpit 0.9.1 or later; 0.9.2 recommended.
author: BronOS
